web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's May exports rose 19.4% year-over-year, accelerating from April's 14.1% gain, while imports expanded 27.4%, surpassing April's 25.3% growth. This robust trade performance, driven by surging AI-related exports, helped buffer the economy against disruptions from the Iran war, with U.S.-bound shipments experiencing a five-year high growth of 35%. The trade surplus reached $105.4 billion in May.
